annotations.title: Give an agent what it needs

description: Gives one thing an agent needs, by its key from needs_read, as the owner would on that agent's card on Agents: saved where the agent reads it, so it is used from the agent's next run. value is what the need's kind takes: words for most, a number, or a list of strings for a list or files. remove true takes back what was given, where the need allows it. A refusal says what the value lacks. Give a value in the owner's own words, as they wrote it, and only what the owner said or a source shows (their site, a document they gave), never a guess. Never a password, a token or a key: those, the accounts to connect and anything that spends the owner gives in Marsell, where needs_read says, and need_set refuses them. A list is given whole, as it should stand, so one left out is taken off. Saving is free; where giving one leads an agent to paid work afterwards, that need's own hint or note in needs_read says so.

key.description: the need's key, as needs_read gives it, like postal_address

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

remove.description: true takes back what was given, where the need allows it; value is then left out

value.description: what the need's kind takes: words for most (a link, an email, an address on one line), a number, or a list of strings for a list or files
